Suomussalmi is 216 km by road from Oulu, the nearest unit by drive time, so 15 breast sessions mean 16 nights away versus 6 with 5 [S60, S59].

1. The radiotherapy lead could evaluate a single 8 Gy session by default for uncomplicated painful bone metastases (equal pain relief, more retreatment), serving "Patients receive treatment within target times" [S31, S30, S62, S25, S24]. Suomussalmi patients expect 6.2 nights away with multiple fractions versus 2.4 with a single 8 Gy session [S60, S59]. Within 30 days, the clinical team reviews which cases suit 1 session [S31, S30].

2. The breast oncology lead could evaluate 5 sessions, non-inferior to 15, by default for eligible patients (whole breast or chest wall without nodal radiotherapy), citing distance, serving "Patients receive treatment within target times" [S9, S11, S15, S14, S25, S24]. Kainuu would avoid 208 nights away and free 208 machine sessions yearly (calculated, breast) [S33, S57, S34, S35, S60]. Within 30 days, the clinical team reviews eligibility [S15, S14].

3. The data lead could publish schedule mix and radiotherapy use by distance band every year, serving "Regional differences in treatment are available and used to steer services (cross-cutting indicator)" [S21, S27, S26]. Within 30 days, the data lead and the clinical team decide which figures to report [S26].

Distances use centre points and the current schedule mix is unknown [S59, S16].
